title: QC 1000 / AS 1215 Engagement-Documentation Gap Checker
description: Check an engagement-file inventory (presence flags only, never file content) against a cited PCAOB AS 1215 / QC 1000 documentation-element checklist and return a gap report. Not a compliance determination.

mcp_tool_definition.name: check_engagement_documentation_gap
